# SQLite

- **Version**: 3.47.1
- **Source**: https://www.sqlite.org/
- **License**: Public Domain
- **Vendored on**: 2024 (pre-existing)
- **Files**: Amalgamation build (`sqlite3.c`, `sqlite3.h`, `sqlite3ext.h`, `shell.c`)

## How to Update

1. Go to https://www.sqlite.org/download.html
2. Download the amalgamation archive
3. Replace `sqlite3.c`, `sqlite3.h`, `sqlite3ext.h` in this directory
4. Update the version in this file
